preview: In this episode, we look at how digital assistants are moving beyond the smartphone and into everyday life. Why does this change matter, and what might it mean for the way people interact with technology?
comment_1: Listen for the places where these new AI features may appear.
comment_2: So, the key change is that digital assistants may work in more places than the phone. How are Amazon and Google bringing this idea to everyday devices?
comment_3: Together, these announcements suggest that digital help is moving into more parts of daily life. The phone is still important, but it is no longer the only place to use these tools. Now, let’s look at what this change means and how it is developing.
comment_4: We have seen how assistants may help connect several actions across devices, rather than simply respond on a screen. At the same time, this change is arriving at different speeds, with some products available and others still planned. Now, let’s bring these ideas together in the closing summary.
